component: Folder picker and filter target display

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original change adds a full prettyPath/account tooltip and opts the filter target into path labels. The fixed picker now formats labels through Fluent and resets the tooltip before setting it; its stored value remains the folder URI. The fixed filter target uses verbose labels again while keeping the full-path tooltip. Move/Copy Again still builds an en-dash tooltip directly. Keep these separate states and do not use the original separator or path-label choice as a global UI convention.
title: Folder picker labels, tooltips and stored URIs follow separate contracts
